proof_summary: For \(n=67\), two distinct witnesses occur: \(147\) has residue sum \(1+3+3+3+19+19+19=67\), while \(2055\) has residue sum \(1+3+9\cdot7=67\), over powers of two up to their respective binary logarithms. Thus the multiplicity at \(67\) is at least two, contradicting the asserted value one.
